objects.taxonomy_description: Ring-shaped bread roll with a glossy, chewy crust and dense interior crumb. The toroidal form features a central hole approximately 2-3 cm in diameter with an overall diameter of 10-12 cm. May be topped with sesame seeds, poppy seeds, or coarse salt.

objects.taxonomy_description: Edible fungus with a characteristic cap-and-stem morphology. The cap (pileus) is convex to flat, typically 3-10 cm in diameter, with a smooth or slightly scaly surface in white, brown, or tan coloration. The underside reveals gills (lamellae) radiating from the stem, ranging from white to dark brown. The cylindrical stem (stipe) is smooth, firm, and white, typically 3-8 cm in length. The overall form is umbrella-like with a fleshy, moist texture.

Flower_or_Top: Cap (pileus) is distinctly fleshy and thick, convex becoming broadly convex to flat only when highly mature.
Smooth or slightly scaly surface in white, brown, or tan coloration.
Underside reveals gills (lamellae) radiating from stem.
Stem_and_Leaves: Cylindrical stem (stipe) is smooth, firm, and white, notably stout relative to the cap width.
Gills range from white to dark brown underneath cap.
Overall umbrella-like form with fleshy, moist texture.
Root_and_Base: Stem base attaches to growing substrate.
Single central stem supporting cap structure.
Fleshy, moist texture throughout fruiting body.

objects.taxonomy_description: Bowed stringed instrument with a curved wooden body approximately 35 cm long. Body has an hourglass shape with C-bouts (inward curves) on each side. Top plate (soundboard) is spruce with two f-shaped sound holes. Back plate is maple with a distinctive flame pattern. Four strings (G, D, A, E) run from a tailpiece at the base over a bridge to tuning pegs in the scroll. Neck extends from the body to a carved scroll at the top. Fingerboard is ebony (black). Varnish finish is amber, reddish-brown, or golden. Chin rest is attached at the lower left. Bow is a wooden stick with horsehair.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Bowed stringed instrument with a curved wooden body of compact, handheld size.
Body has an hourglass shape with C-bouts on each side.
Neck extends from the body to a carved scroll at the top.
Functional_Components: Four strings run from a tailpiece over a bridge to tuning pegs in the scroll.
Top plate has two f-shaped sound holes.
Fingerboard is ebony black with a chin rest attached at the lower left.
Material_and_Context: Top plate is spruce; back plate is maple with a distinctive flame pattern.
